test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_lc_keys (id UInt64, m Map(LowCardinality(String), String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_lc_keys SELECT number, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(x -> concat('k', leftPad(toString(x), 2, '0')), range(20)), arrayMap(x -> concat('v', toString(cityHash64(number, x) % 1000)), range(20))) FROM numbers(1500000)
test.query: SELECT sum(ignore(m['k00'])) FROM map_lc_keys SETTINGS max_threads = 1

test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_uuid_keys (id UInt64, m Map(UUID, DateTime64(3))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_uuid_keys SELECT number, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(x -> reinterpretAsUUID(toFixedString(leftPad(toString(x), 16, '0'), 16)), range(20)), arrayMap(x -> toDateTime64(number + x, 3), range(20))) FROM numbers(1000000)
